About Wikipedia Disclaimers Search Beyond Measure ( Jeremy Camp album ) Article Talk Language Watch Edit Beyond Measure is the fifth album by Jeremy Camp , released on October 31 , 2006 . It includes the singles , `` Tonight `` , `` What It Means '' and `` Let It Fade `` . A special edition version of the album was released on March 27 , 2007 . Beyond Measure Studio
